summary: Aterian disclosed a change-in-control-related distribution of preferred stock. Under an April 27, 2026 Securities Purchase Agreement, David E. Lazar held 1,750,000 Series AA and 1,750,000 Series AAA preferred shares convertible into common. On September 25, 2026, Lazar sold 706,100 Series AA and all 1,750,000 Series AAA preferred shares to several purchasers for $12,000,000 aggregate. Immediately before the sale, the preferred converted into 241,861,970 common shares. Post-sale, Lazar holds ~3.1% of common; no purchaser exceeds 9.99% fully diluted, and no group is deemed to have acquired control.
